chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said regarding the eulogy of the Ansar:

key_terms.الْأَنْصَارِ: The Ansar, the native helpers of Medina who supported the Prophet and the Muhajirun.

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the Ansar?
ai.summary: In this passage from Nahj al-Balagha, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights the Ansar's pivotal role not merely as political allies but as the spiritual and material backbone of the early Muslim community. This praise underscores their enduring status in Shia tradition as exemplars of loyalty (wilayah) and selflessness, distinguishing their contribution from the later political shifts in Medina. The eulogy serves as a theological reminder of the value of sincere support for the Prophet's mission, a theme central to understanding the Ahl al-Bayt's relationship with the broader Ummah.
